description:
This no cook/cold process oreo gelato is so easy and tastes amazing. When your ingredients don't need heating to either hydrate, disolve or something else, then why do it!
This Oreo Gelato has an amazing mouthfeel and texture, the taste lingers in your mouth and you will love it as you can prep it and churn it within 10 minutes. 

What you'll need for this Oreo Gelato:

600g of 2% Milk
150g of 33% cream
165g Sugar
40g Dextrose
65g Skimmed Milk Powder
1.7-2.5g Xanthan Gum ( i used approximately 2.5g)

Crushed Oreo powder (for the above size recipe, use 8 oreos but NO CREAM)
Broken Oreos (use as many as you think you can handle 😉🤣 )

----------------------

If you want to see me talk about Guar Gum, check out this video:
https://youtu.be/KrvLeh8tr-E?si=SN9ZPYf50V2xUjxE

----------------------

comments.text:
So dropping the sugar somewhat is possible but it does affect the structure of the ice cream due to reduced solids. You COULD reduce the sugar (knowing it will be harder from the freezer) and increase the skimmed milk powder to up the solids a bit. Whilst this isn’t without fault, the result can be pretty good. Start with 80g of sugar and increase the SMP by 10g and see what the result is 👍
Allulose isn’t in Canada either but you can use other sugar substitutes. I will use allulose which I’ve brought in from the US but have had excellent results with other combos. I’ll cover these alternatives in the sugar free video. (EDIT for stupid auto correct).

comments.text:
Hi! 
Ok so Number 1: yes no problem. 

Number 2: the Skimmed Milk Powder is essential in dairy ice creams to get the MSNF up to the desired level without increasing the fat content. It also helps stabilize the water a bit at the same time. 

Number 3: sugar free recipes are a pain in the backside. People think it’s simply just swapping out the sugar substitute but it’s really not and the results are usually terrible at best. 

Number 4: yes to a degree, if you are going to sub out the vanilla and use another extract then yes it’ll be fine. 

Finally, we no longer live in the UK 🇬🇧 👍 welcome to the ice cream family and ask any questions you may have. 
I am doing a sugar substitute video in 2 weeks so stay tuned ✌️
